scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,order,pos -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w kiosk-app" "npm run dev -w pos-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w kiosk-app && npm run build -w pos-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w print-agent
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w kiosk-app && npm run lint -w pos-app
